mechanism_observation_taxonomy.INITIAL_COMPLETE: A0 reviewed claims already contain all target necessary relations and accepted V1 declares complete; retain claim/relationship evidence, not verdict alone.
mechanism_observation_taxonomy.EA1_BACKING_RESOLVED: EA_ADMISSION records RESOLVED_EXACT_BACKING with actual parent/child/offset identity. Participation in successful target answer requires traceable relevant child citations; resolution alone does not prove effect.
mechanism_observation_taxonomy.C1_GAP_DETECTED_REVISIONABLE: Accepted V1 records ESTABLISHED unsatisfied ADMITTED_BACKING_AVAILABLE relation and A1 actual scope includes it.
mechanism_observation_taxonomy.C1_GAP_BLOCKED_VISIBLE_ONLY: Necessary visible-only relation is unsatisfied and excluded from A1 repair authority.
mechanism_observation_taxonomy.C1_GAP_AMBIGUOUS: Uncertain check and uncertain point scope, incomplete/non-revisionable; overflow recorded separately as blocked, never forced into uncertainty.
mechanism_observation_taxonomy.A1_RECOVERY_SUCCESS: Initially missing target relation is observed; C1 authorizes bounded A1; post-merge/V2 and existing final evaluator establish recovered target relation. No global causal attribution.
mechanism_observation_taxonomy.A1_RECOVERY_FAILED: Observed authorized recovery leaves target relation absent/incomplete or removed; retain actual merge disposition and final verdict.
mechanism_observation_taxonomy.C1_FALSE_ACCEPTANCE_RECURRENCE: Only when retained reviewed claims establish target relation absent while actual production C1 review declares its point complete. Final judge disagreement alone is insufficient; absent trace means NOT_ESTABLISHED.
mechanism_observation_taxonomy.TARGET_MECHANISM_NOT_NEEDED: Initial answer succeeds without the target recovery stage; scientific PASS is allowed; do not claim recovery proven.
mechanism_observation_taxonomy.NOT_OBSERVABLE: Required trace missing/corrupt/insufficient for classification; NOT_ESTABLISHED for uncertain semantic or causal inference.

mechanism_interpretation: Ordered multiple descriptive labels allowed. Use retained structured trace, existing final judge and deterministic evaluator plus fixed Gold criteria. No additional LLM judge. No causal claim from activation alone; unsure => NOT_ESTABLISHED / NOT_OBSERVABLE.

scientific_outcome_rule.FAIL: Any scientifically valid fixed sentinel/control fails its fixed criterion, or valid hard-safety/trustworthiness violation occurs. Takes precedence over missing later cases/trace.
scientific_outcome_rule.PASS: All four sentinels PASS, all four controls CONTROL_PASS, all eight scientifically complete under bound identity, no hard-safety/trustworthiness failure.
scientific_outcome_rule.INCONCLUSIVE: Neither FAIL nor PASS established due to infrastructure, transport, resource limit or identity failure. Missing trace alone does not invalidate a valid scientific final answer/judge result.

mechanism_observability_rule.COMPLETE: Both g013/g023 permit classification of initial answer, EA admission, V1, A1 authorization/non-activation and V2 if applicable. Natural non-activation observable and valid.
mechanism_observability_rule.PARTIAL: Valid scientific output, some target stage unclassifiable, but some target mechanism interpretation retained.
mechanism_observability_rule.FAILED: Required target trace absent/corrupt enough to prevent mechanism interpretation.

overall_verdict_rule.FAIL: Scientific outcome FAIL, even if mechanism trace incomplete.
overall_verdict_rule.PASS: Scientific outcome PASS AND mechanism observability COMPLETE.
overall_verdict_rule.INCONCLUSIVE: No valid scientific FAIL and either scientific completion/identity/resources unavailable OR target observability PARTIAL/FAILED. Valid poor outputs never become INCONCLUSIVE.
